No game discs, digital library screen, or case artwork is shown in any photo.

risks.proof: Video clip of console powering on to the home screen, or photo of the screen displaying system settings.

risks.risk: Bundled '10 latest games' and the specific FIFA/PES titles are unverified and one named title appears fictitious.
risks.proof: Screenshot of the console's game library/menu showing installed titles, or physical discs/cases in a photo.

risks.risk: No power cable, HDMI cable, or original box shown, which affects completeness of the bundle.
risks.proof: Photo laid out showing all accessories (power cable, HDMI cable, box) alongside the console.

risks.risk: Only one controller visible; buyer may assume two are included based on common bundles.
risks.proof: Photo showing a second controller if one exists.

risks.risk: Shrink wrap on a 'used/customised' console is unusual and could indicate a re-wrapped or stock photo rather than the actual unit being sold.
risks.proof: Fresh photo of the actual unit unwrapped, taken by the seller with a timestamp or handwritten note.
risks.if_unproven: priced as condition unverified, treated as used with cosmetic wear assumed

proof_requests: A video of the console powering on and reaching the home/dashboard screen.
A photo or screen capture of the installed games library to verify the '10 games' and specific titles claimed.
A photo showing all included accessories: power cable, HDMI cable, and any controllers.
A fresh, unwrapped photo of the actual unit (not a stock/dealer image) to confirm current cosmetic condition.
response.reason: The item is identifiable as a blue custom-design PS4 Slim console with one controller, so it can be priced at worst case (unverified function, no games, single controller, missing accessories) while the power-on, game bundle, and accessory claims remain unproven.
